gemini.title: Boundary Census Country Of Birth And Nationality Data Lgd
gemini.abstract: Boundary Census Country Of Birth And Nationality Data Lgd is an authoritative dataset published by Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency. It represents boundary census country of birth and nationality data lgd features using multipolygon geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by the Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency as open statistics and boundary data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
gemini.responsible_organisation: Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency
